rule: the first 100 LEARNING ticks of the school replay, run twice from the clean reference, give an identical checkpoint digest and an identical sha256 of the LESSON log
normalisation: the fields ['t', 'path'] are removed before hashing, as experiments/d10/determinism.py does: a second process cannot reproduce a wall clock or an absolute path
why: the journal stamps its branch on every record; the two runs live in two directories but are stamped with one name, so a difference in the logs can only be a difference in the run
